shortDescription: Creates an OpenStack server based on VMware source VM information

options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters for OpenStack. Can include auth_url, username, password, project_name, domain_name, etc.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Availability zone to create the server in.

options.name: boot_from_volume
options.description: Whether to boot the server from a volume. If true, must specify either image_id (to create boot volume from image) or volume_id in the first volume entry.

options.name: flavor_id
options.description: ID of the flavor to use for the server.

options.name: image_id
options.description: ID of the image to use for the server. Only used when not booting from volume.

options.name: instance_scheduler
options.description: Decides whether the instance should be scheduled somewhere by the scheduler or directly built on a specified host.

options.name: key_name
options.description: Name of the SSH key to inject into the server.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Dictionary of metadata to apply to the server.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the server to create.

options.name: networks
options.description: List of networks to attach to the server. Each network should be specified as a dict with at least a 'uuid' key. Can also include 'fixed_ip' if a specific IP address is requested.

options.name: region_name
options.description: OpenStack region to create the server in.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: List of security group names to apply to the server.

options.name: source_vm_json_path
options.description: Path to the JSON file containing source VM information from VMware. Used to configure the server based on the source VM's specifications.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the server. Only 'present' is currently supported as this module is focused on creation.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for server creation operation.

options.name: user_data
options.description: User data to pass to the instance. This is generally used for cloud-init scripts.

options.name: volumes
options.description: List of volume specifications to attach to the server. Each volume should be specified as a dict with keys like 'id', 'device', 'boot_index', etc.

options.name: wait
options.description: Whether to wait for the server to reach active state before returning.
